Team,

As we approach the second quarter, I want to outline our strategic priorities and discuss the preliminary budget allocations for each department.

PRIORITIES:
1. The Operations team, led by Cameron Dean, will focus on streamlining our supply chain processes and reducing overhead costs by 15%. Please coordinate with the logistics division to identify areas for improvement.

3. Marvin Taylor will prepare a detailed financial forecast incorporating the revised revenue projections we discussed in Monday's executive session.

I have scheduled a follow-up meeting for April 18, 2026 to review progress. Cameron Dean, please reserve Conference Room A.
